question: Should runtime/gateway JSON message and reason fields become locale-dependent through the wizard i18n catalog, or should protocol-facing fields stay stable while only display surfaces are localized?
rationale: The PR intentionally localizes gateway-facing message/reason strings that clients may consume, and repository policy treats provider routing, gateway protocol, fallback behavior, and message delivery as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Keep Protocol Fields Stable
options.body: Localize chat/display copy while preserving stable gateway error/message/reason contracts or adding explicit display-only fields for translated text.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Fields
options.body: Allow locale-dependent gateway strings if maintainers confirm current code/type fields are the only supported client contract and add upgrade-proof notes/tests.

options.title: Pause Runtime Scope
options.body: Defer runtime/gateway localization until maintainers choose a broader localization architecture and ownership model.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol Fields Stable
recommendation.body: Localize chat/display copy while preserving stable gateway error/message/reason contracts or adding explicit display-only fields for translated text.
